title: Dataset
description: One published dataset, aligned with DCAT and expressed as a schema.org Dataset. Every gov-schema profile a publisher serves should also appear here as a dataset, so that a consumer arriving through an open-data portal finds the structured data rather than only a CSV of it.

description.description: A plain-language description of what this dataset contains.

url.description: Where this dataset's canonical human-readable page lives.

identifier.description: Any scheme-qualified identifiers for this dataset beyond its `@id`.

creator.description: Who produced the data, when different from the publisher.

includedInDataCatalog.description: The `Catalog` this dataset is listed in.

keywords.description: Search terms someone looking for this dataset might use.

dataTheme.description: termCode(s) from the DataTheme code list, aligned with the EU data-theme vocabulary that DCAT-AP uses.

updateFrequency.description: How often this is refreshed, as an ISO 8601 duration (P1D, P1M) or 'continuous' or 'irregular'. DCAT dct:accrualPeriodicity. A dataset with no stated cadence cannot be told apart from an abandoned one.

accessRights.description: DCAT dct:accessRights. 'restricted' means the metadata is public but the data is not.

spatialCoverage.description: The `Jurisdiction` or area this dataset covers.

datePublished.description: When this dataset was first published.

license.description: The licence this dataset is published under.

inLanguage.description: The language(s) this dataset is published in.

conformsToProfile.description: The gov-schema profile this dataset serves, where it serves one. This is what links an open-data catalogue entry to structured gov-schema data.

distribution.description: The actual files or endpoints. A dataset with no distribution is an announcement, not data.

accessUrl.description: DCAT dcat:accessURL: a landing page or API root, where there is no direct download.

conformsTo.description: External standards this dataset follows, e.g. an Akoma Ntoso or OpenAPI version. DCAT dct:conformsTo. Distinct from conformanceLevel.

applicableLegislation.description: Legislation mandating or governing this dataset, typically an ELI URI. Observed on EU portals under the Open Data Directive; a direct join from catalog to the code profile.

hvdCategory.description: EU High Value Dataset category URI. A legal classification under the Open Data Directive, not a subject theme.

highValueDataset.description: Whether this dataset is designated a High Value Dataset under the EU Open Data Directive. See `hvdCategory` for which category.

spatialReferenceSystem.description: EPSG code of the dataset's coordinate reference system, e.g. 'epsg:2157'. GeoJSON mandates WGS84 but national grids are in daily use, so an international profile cannot assume it.

provenanceStatement.description: A plain-language note on where the data comes from and how it's produced, where that isn't obvious from the publisher alone.
